layout_and_spacing.spacing_philosophy: Generous spacing (p-6, p-8, gap-6, gap-8) with clear contrast and non-colliding container paddings.

grid_modes.search_and_hero: MODE A: Hero search bar with multi-tab selector (Flights, Hotels, Buses, Cabs) elevated over high-resolution imagery.
grid_modes.results_and_sidebar: MODE B: 2-column layout with responsive filter sidebar (left, col-span-3) and search result cards (right, col-span-9).
grid_modes.dashboard_bento: MODE A: Bento layout for My Bookings, Pin-to-Trip itinerary board, and Multilingual Voice Concierge.

key_features_and_flows: Unified Multi-Tab Hero Search (Flights, Hotels, Buses, Cabs)
Intelligence Multilingual AI Travel Concierge with Browser Native Voice Speech Synthesis & Microphone Input (Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, English, Marathi, Gujarati, Kannada)
Akbar API Integration Bridge & Dynamic Live Data Mocking
Search Results Page with Comprehensive Filters (Price slider, Stops, Airline/Operator, Amenities, Departure Time)
Detail View & Booking Drawer with Gallery, Cabin/Room Options, Transparent Price Breakdown
Razorpay Payment Gateway Integration for Seamless INR Checkout
User Dashboard: My Bookings, E-Voucher Viewer with QR Code & Print PDF option, Saved Trips Board

component_guidelines.testing_attributes: EVERY interactive element (buttons, inputs, selects, tabs, cards, modals, dropdowns) MUST include a unique descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case e.g. data-testid='flight-search-submit-btn', data-testid='hotel-filter-price-range'.
component_guidelines.toast_notifications: Use Sonner component at src/components/ui/sonner.jsx for booking status, voice assistance triggers, and login alerts.
component_guidelines.accessibility_and_contrast: Ensure min 4.5:1 text contrast ratio on dark and light surfaces. Never use pure transparent header backgrounds when scrolling.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all 4 tabs (Flights, Hotels, Buses, Cabs) in the main search bar are fully interactive with rich destination autocomplete and real-time result filtering.

Provide a floating and expandable Multilingual AI Voice Assistant panel. Use browser native SpeechRecognition and SpeechSynthesis APIs for speaking & listening in Hindi, English, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, etc.
Include Akbar API backend/mock integration layer in FastAPI python service to simulate live flight, hotel, bus, and cab availability.
Implement Razorpay Checkout modal with test payment flow for INR transactions and booking voucher generation.
Ensure Google OAuth + Email Password login modals and session state are fully hooked up with data-testid on submit buttons.
Do not break existing React components in src/components/ui. Use .js and .jsx files for custom implementation.
